name: IDC `cptac_lscc` (tier 2)
what: IDC v24 collection cptac_lscc (TCIA doi:10.7937/k9/tcia.2018.6emub5l2), tier 2 of the anomaly harvest: 32 subjects, about 8.3 GB raw plus screen; chest, abdomen, pelvis and whole body
level_truth: counted by the census pipeline once fetched
status: planned in the data platform at bf1432f; fetch job in the 2026-10-21 chain after idc_tier2.csv is regenerated; the ranking's refusals: slice over 3.0 mm 46, non-axial reformat 29, localizer 16, not a regularly spaced 3-D volume 12
how_to_get: Regenerate the tier-2 manifest idc_tier2.csv with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's tools/acquisition_census.py (its inputs aa3_meta.csv and fdg_ct_series.json are not on local disk), then slurm/acquisition_submit.sh tier2; or this one collection alone, filtering that manifest on its first column as the tier-1 cards do.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_cptac_lscc; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_cptac_lscc",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
